focus: P3 exact cross-adapter authorized trace schema, schedule equivalence, and adversarial parity matrix
noveltyJustification: Iterations 004-005 established prefix oracles, timing distinctions, and normalization boundaries; this pass resolves the remaining P3 ambiguity with an exact trace field schema, accepted-versus-refused dual-ledger rules, a schedule-equivalence contract, eight concrete concurrency families, and pinned single-defect mutant expectations.
keyFindings: CrossAdapterTraceV1 is a manifest-bound ordered sequence of authorized operation prefixes rather than terminal observation classes
Accepted and refused prefixes have distinct joinable domain/audit evidence and refusal proves zero domain budget and effect mutation
Every projection checkpoint binds an independently authored closed-prefix digest plus load-bearing selectors
Adapter equivalence is exact semantic equality under a closed path-specific reversible normalization allowlist
Allowable nondeterminism is a manifest-declared partial order over proven-disjoint operations rather than whole-trace sorting
The minimum schedule suite covers independent commutation head conflicts stale claim successors clock boundaries denial concurrency effect ambiguity and gate invalidation
Every positive case requires a pinned single-defect plausible-wrong mutant with expected class and earliest mismatch
